name: HR certification reimbursement policy example
answer:
Employees may request reimbursement for approved professional certifications up to $1,200 per calendar year.
Requests must be submitted within 45 days of the exam date.
The company guarantees reimbursement for every certification attempt.

sources.title: HR Certification Reimbursement Policy
sources.content: Employees may request reimbursement for manager-approved professional certifications up to $1,200 per calendar year. Requests must be submitted within 30 days of the exam date. Reimbursement is subject to annual budget availability and is not guaranteed for every attempt.
